_how_to_add_a_shop: Team: after approving an application, add an object to 'shops' (unique id, Thai/English names, area, description, items). Items use side 'shop' (they sell) or 'buy' (they buy). 'img' is optional (put the photo in img/market/). Never put personal phone numbers or ID numbers here.
